name: home-dns-codegen-tools
description: Isolated devtool dependencies used only by scripts/generate-frontend-types.sh. openapi-typescript needs the classic TypeScript compiler API (ts.factory) internally and is not yet compatible with TypeScript 7 (which dashboard/frontend is pinned to for the app itself) — see docs/technical-debt.md. Kept in its own package.json/lockfile so the two never conflict; never imported by application code.
